definitions.explanation: A loose outer garment made of one piece of cloth with a hole for the head, worn for warmth or, in waterproof form, as rainwear.

examples.japanese: ポンチョ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{着|き}る→着る：00541_kiru⟧。

examples.english: On rainy days I wear a poncho on my bike.

examples.japanese: ⟦{野外|やがい}→野外：17152_yagai⟧⟦フェス→フェス：06697_fesu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}く→行く：00119_iku⟧とき⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{急|きゅう}→急：13042_kyuu⟧な⟦{雨|あめ}→雨：00583_ame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{備|そな}えて→備える：02125_sonaeru⟧ポンチョ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持|も}っていく→持っていく：27431_motteiku⟧。
examples.english: When I go to an outdoor festival, I take a poncho in case of sudden rain.

notes:
A rain poncho (レインポンチョ) is popular with cyclists, since it covers the handlebars too.
